sentences.text: Taylor Swift is the debut studio album by American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift , released on October 24 , 2006 , by Big Machine Records .	Taylor Swift	Taylor Swift	Big Machine	Big Machine Records	Big Machine Records	Big Machine Records
Swift was 16 years old at the time of the album 's release and wrote its songs during her freshman year of high school .	freshman year	freshman year	s	Billboard (magazine)
Swift has writing credits on all of the album 's songs , including those co-written with Liz Rose .	Liz Rose	Liz Rose	s	Billboard (magazine)

Swift experimented with several producers , ultimately choosing Nathan Chapman , who had produced her demo album .	Nathan Chapman	Nathan Chapman (record producer)	producers	record producer	demo album	demo album

Musically , the album is country music styled , and lyrically it speaks of romantic relationships , a couple of which Swift wrote from observing relationships before being in one .	country music	country music
Lyrics also touch on Swift 's personal struggles in high school .	s	Billboard (magazine)

Five singles were released from the album , all of which have been certified platinum by the RIAA .	certified platinum	Music recording sales certification	RIAA	Recording Industry Association of America

`` Tim McGraw '' was released as the lead single and reached the top ten on Billboard 's Hot Country Songs .	Country	Country music	Tim McGraw	Tim McGraw	lead single	lead single	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)	Hot Country Songs	Hot Country Songs	s	Billboard (magazine)
